walk_rule: every walk of at most complete_to_bp bases from the seed boundary is present when it uses no (k+1)-mer edge twice on its own path (edges are compared as canonical (k+1)-mers, each use keeping its orientation), enters no seed node (of either strand), and may take hairpin steps (a self-reverse-complementary (k+1)-mer), which are flagged; after a reconvergence the merged walk is also barred from every edge used by any route merged into it (edge histories are united under on_reconverge: merge, so fewer walks are present than per path; on_reconverge: keep gives the per-path set); it is followed while some permitted label supports every node of it under the strategy's label rules
